title: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter
responsibility: Preserve an assigned task submission in a source-bound checkpoint and publish complete committed module metadata before returning its revision.

inputs.name: checkpoint.input
inputs.description: cwd is same-repository detached task worktree with HEAD equal to source. paths must be exact changed files already checked by taskWrites against prepared role-specific grant; adapter uses literal pathspecs.

outputs.name: checkpoint
outputs.description: Verifies same canonical Git common directory and exact worktree HEAD. For changed paths creates a commit object with parent source using private temporary index, generic author fallback, preserving source HEAD, branch refs and user index; empty paths return source unchanged. Before returning either revision, publishes module metadata via ModuleDataService.validate({commit,write:true}) and admits it via require. Requires valid and committed metadata; evidence gaps are reported and do not block. Finally removes only its private index directory; task worktree retained for review.

errors.name: Incomplete checkpoint metadata
errors.type: Error rejection with safe validation command for exact checkpoint; never return an unreadable successful revision
